paper_grounding.basis_summary: I directly read all cited passages. The paper defines a sub-multi-sequence by restriction to an infinite subbase, identifies that subbase by fixed-left composition f_X composed with g, defines shift by right composition with successor, and obtains the perfect-or-complement alternative by first coloring h(x) versus h(ShiftMap x), then applying Nash-Williams to the deciding front of that Boolean coloring. Subarr is stated for arbitrary multi-sequences and super-sequences, so the repaired base clause must retain arbitrary infinite bases rather than silently specialize to global IncSeq.
